Name: Toriel and Frisk from Undertale
Author: camil0
Description:
I created this mod long ago for my current game, so I just wanted to share it...

I like how the portraits look but the sprites aren't really good (specially Frisk because at the time I used Vincent's sprite but not the Jas' soooo [b]DO NOT GO UNDERTHE TREE[/b] because a funny situation will happen) .
While I created this mod I was wondering to add more characters from Undertale but doing some of them I didn't get the results that I was expecting..


[size=1]special credits to Toby Fox, ConcernedApe and the modding community of this game that I love
[/size]
Install it as a Content Patcher mod so just move the thing and place it in the thing 
If you have a problem, please leave a comment.

Manifest.Description: Replaces Jas and Marnie to add Toriel(humanized) and Frisk from Undertale, modified by camil0
